tooltip: 1. Credit carryforward from 2025. Enter the amount from line 4 of your 2025 Form 8859.
2. Limitation based on tax liability. Enter the amount from the Tax Liability Limit Worksheet in the instructions below.
3. Current-year credit. Enter the smaller of line 1 or line 2 here. Include this amount on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6h. See your tax return instructions.
4. Credit carryforward to 2027. Subtract line 3 from line 1.
Tax Liability Limit Worksheet—Line 2. 1. Enter the tax liability before the application of credits from your 2026 income tax return (Form 1040, 1040-S R, or 1040-N R, line 18).

2. Enter the total of the following credit(s)/adjustment(s) if you are taking the credit(s)/adjustment(s) on your 2026 income tax return. Amount on Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6l. Foreign tax credit, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 1. Credit for child and dependent care expenses, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 2. Credit for the elderly or the disabled, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6d. Nonrefundable education credits, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 3. Retirement savings contributions credit, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 4. Credit for previously owned clean vehicles, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6m. Clean vehicle credit, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6f. Child tax credit or credit for other dependents, Form 1040, 1040-S R, or 1040-N R, line 19.* *Include the amount from line 14 of Credit Limit Worksheet B in the Instructions for Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) instead of the amount from Form 1040, 1040-S R, or 1040-N R, line 19, if the Instructions for Schedule 8812 (Form 1040) direct you to complete Credit Limit Worksheet B. Mortgage Interest Credit, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6g. Adoption Credit, Schedule 3 (Form 1040), line 6c. Note: Enter the total of the preceding credit(s)/adjustment(s) only if allowed and taken on your 2026 income tax return. Not all credits/adjustments are available for all years or for all filers. See the instructions for your 2026 income tax return.
3. Subtract line 2 from line 1. Enter this amount on Form 8859, line 2. If zero or less, enter 0 here and on Form 8859, lines 2 and 3.
